meaning: Low flame sense: flame sense current is weak or marginal. Furnace keeps running.
causes: Flame sense rod needs cleaning or is not properly connected
Wiring between rod and control shorted or open
Improperly mounted or poorly grounded flame sensor
diySteps: Technician: clean or replace the flame sense rod and check connections
Technician: reinstall/replace sensor and confirm furnace ground
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: to service the sensor before it causes lockouts.
